_comment: Per-runway Google Chat webhook URL overrides for restart-monitor notifications. Keyed by runway slug (matches data/grafana-runways.json). When a slug has a non-empty URL here, it overrides chatWebhookEnv from .env. Managed via admin/service-severity.html → Webhooks modal. `enabled` map (managed via admin/scheduled-noti.html) gates the cron notification per runway — when false, _notify.php skips sending for that slug.
